title: 24小时交易很香：英伟达苹果却退出，流动性难题怎么破
speaker: Gracie Lin

segments.en: Speaking of blockchain, tokenization. Of course, that's allowed for 24-7 trading.
segments.zh: 说到区块链和代币化，当然允许24小时全天候交易。

segments.en: But the likes of Nvidia, Apple, I think even JP Morgan have opted out.
segments.zh: 但像英伟达、苹果，甚至摩根大通都选择退出。

segments.en: Yes. What are the concerns there? And how is there being addressed?
segments.zh: 是的，那其中的担忧是什么？又如何解决？

segments.en: With every new technology innovation, there are always going to be concerns.
segments.zh: 每一次新技术创新，总会伴随担忧。

segments.en: And in this case, specifically, I think the concern is the volatility.
segments.zh: 而在这个案例中，具体来说，我认为担忧在于波动性。

segments.en: I mean, if you think about liquidity, everybody wants it to be concentrated in one place.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，考虑到流动性，大家都希望它集中在一个地方。

segments.en: Every time you have multiple channels, there's always a concern about liquidity.
segments.zh: 每当有多个渠道时，总会担心流动性问题。

segments.en: When you think about, you know, 24-7 trading is something that everybody wants.
segments.zh: 想想看，24小时交易是每个人都想要的。

segments.en: 24-7 trading and settlement. But at what cost? What's the price for it?
segments.zh: 24小时交易和结算，但代价是什么？价格是多少？

segments.en: Liquidity is always going to be top of mind. But that's to be expected, right?
segments.zh: 流动性始终是首要考虑，但这也是意料之中的，对吧？

segments.en: With any new technology, it takes time for adoption. The early adopters, the early movers, hopefully will demonstrate the value of having
segments.zh: 任何新技术都需要时间普及。早期采用者和先行者有望展示参与这一趋势和新方向的价值，然后其他人会跟进。

segments.en: of being part of that movement and that new direction and then others will come.
segments.zh: 参与这一趋势和新方向，然后其他人会跟进。

segments.en: What did you say? It is a chicken and egg situation.
segments.zh: 你说什么？这是一个先有鸡还是先有蛋的情况。

segments.en: And for liquidity to actually come on board, it's going to be the likes of JP Morgan and Nvidia to come.
segments.zh: 而要让流动性真正进入，需要像摩根大通和英伟达这样的机构参与。

segments.en: And I mean, like, how do you see this being resolved? It's very similar to if you think about the history of crypto, right?
segments.zh: 我的意思是，你认为这如何解决？这非常类似于加密行业的历史，对吧？

segments.en: It took years for the believers, the early movers, and the early days.
segments.zh: 信仰者和早期先行者花了数年时间。

segments.en: And then over time, they kept building, they kept building, and they showed some of the concerns that people had, valid concerns, volatility and liquidity again.
segments.zh: 然后随着时间的推移，他们不断建设，他们展示了人们的一些担忧，合理的担忧，波动性和流动性再次出现。

segments.en: But over time as the demand came in slowly but surely and the direction became very clear, then the traditional established institutions
segments.zh: 但随着时间的推移，需求缓慢但坚定地到来，方向变得非常清晰，然后传统老牌机构

segments.en: will come in as well. And I believe the same is going to play out here.
segments.zh: 也会进来。我相信这里也会上演同样的情况。

segments.en: And it's just a matter of time. As you look to the next 12, 36 months, even, I mean, how is OKX positioning itself
segments.zh: 这只是时间问题。展望未来12、36个月，OKX如何定位自己

segments.en: and what's the growth strategy?
segments.zh: 增长策略是什么？
